scope: Shipped legacy parse-once versus the same source with the reuse disabled. One unchanged probe, one timed synchronous prepareLoad per fresh process, three pairs per scale AB/BA/AB, one window. Not the plan 9.2 nine-pair formal unit and not a load or stage acceptance.
head: a422e52766e7e9086ea7b783217487fe995bf057

baseline.role: reuse disabled: loadDocumentStage ignores the dispatcher bytes and the canonical writer re-parses the text

candidate.role: shipped product behaviour: the canonical bytes come from the same parsed tree

a_side: The baseline build differs from HEAD only by the six-line edit in a-side.patch; the source was restored before this registration was written.

probe.fixture: synthetic legacy Chart v1: entities objects on a square grid, one transform plus one renderable each, two assets from assets/projects/stage3_project

design.order: pair 0 AB, pair 1 BA, pair 2 AB
design.timing: one timed prepareLoad per process; the fixture is built before the timer and commit/update/extract/digest run after it

decision_rule: Declared before measurement. The A/B quantity is the paired log ratio of the prepare median with a Student-t interval over the three pairs. The product arm must not regress: an upper bound above 1.10 is recorded as a regression, not as noise. Identity and frame digest must match across all processes of a scale. No threshold is changed and no candidate is selected by this run.
validity: exit code 0, 'All tests passed' in the log, exactly one PREPARE_RESULT line with entities equal to the scale. Invalid processes are kept and never replaced.
